name: create-video-by-ai
title: 从图像或文本生成视频
description: Get AI-generated videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your images or text (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB), say something like "turn these images and script into a 30-second promotional video", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for marketers, content creators, small business owners who move fast and want to produce videos quickly without filming or editing skills.
title_en: Create Video by AI — Generate Videos from Images or Text
